versions.changelog: Remove SumatraPDF/soffice from requires.bins; scripts locate them via path search

- Initial release of Print Assist: print files with natural language instructions—no print dialogs required.
- Supports PDFs, Office documents, images, and photos; advanced print parameters (layout, duplex, page range, watermark, photo editing with Adobe CC).
- Preview feature included for layout-heavy jobs (e.g., 2-up, rotated, booklet).
- Compatible with Windows; automates setup for SumatraPDF and LibreOffice.
- Details task routing for common print and editing operations.
- Transparent limitations noted for PDF editing and advanced image processing.
